Downloaded October 11, 2026 as 1K PNG archives. Archive hashes and exact URLs are
in sources.json. Color and Roughness maps resized to the recorded size. NormalGL
maps resized, renormalized and renamed Normal. Original OpenGL (+Y) convention.
MetallicSmoothness derived: R=0, G=B=0, A=255-Roughness for these two dielectrics.
No displacement geometry or baked lighting added. FacadeStone is a proposed
marble-cladding finish, not a measured match to the reference facade.

The ten other Roughness/MetallicSmoothness pairs are original project-generated
constant maps from the scalar values in StoreKit.cs, not scanned roughness data.
Author/source: project preparation with Codex; Tools/prepare_night_materials.py.
No third-party content in those constant maps; no third-party attribution required.
Existing ReferenceTextures Color/Normal maps have not been replaced or relicensed.
